reviews.text:
This cleansing oil has a really nice lightweight texture and spreads easily over the skin.
It removes sunscreen and makeup very well without making my skin feel dry afterwards.
It emulsifies quickly with water and rinses off without leaving a heavy oily film.
My skin feels clean and soft after using it, rather than tight or stripped.
reviews.zh:
呢款潔面油質地好輕盈，好容易推開喺皮膚上。
佢可以好好地卸走防曬同化妝，用完之後唔會令皮膚覺得乾。
佢遇水好快就會乳化，沖走之後唔會留低厚重嘅油膜。
用完之後，我嘅皮膚感覺乾淨、柔軟，而唔係緊繃或者被奪走水分。

reviews.text:
I loved this cleansing oil! It has a richer, thicker texture than a lot of other oils, which I really like. When oils are too runny, they absorb quickly so you have to keep adding more, plus they end up dripping down your hands and getting into your eyes, which I absolutely hate.
Because of that thicker texture, it cleanses the skin really well and helps unclog pores. I can literally feel the blackheads and sebaceous filaments rolling out under my fingers as I massage it in. It doesn't clog my pores or irritate my skin at all.
it’s going to last a long time. I’m super happy with it and will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢款潔面油！佢嘅質地比好多其他油類產品更加濃稠、更厚身，我非常喜歡。油太稀嘅話，好快就吸收，所以你要不斷加多啲，而且會流到手上，甚至流入眼睛，我真係好憎呢點。
因為質地較厚，佢清潔皮膚效果好好，亦有助疏通毛孔。我按摩嗰陣，甚至感覺到黑頭同皮脂絲喺手指下滾出嚟。佢唔會堵塞毛孔，亦完全唔會刺激皮膚。
佢應該可以用好耐。我非常滿意，會再買！

reviews.text: I really love this cleansing oil from Round Lab! It has a lightweight texture and glides smoothly over the skin, making it easy to remove makeup, sunscreen, and impurities. It emulsifies nicely with water and rinses off without leaving my skin feeling greasy or dry. After cleansing, my skin feels soft, fresh, and comfortable. I especially love how gentle it is while still cleansing effectively. Overall, I’m very happy with this cleansing oil and would definitely recommend it! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 Round Lab 呢款潔面油！質地輕盈，喺皮膚上滑得好順，好容易卸走化妝、防曬同污垢。遇水可以好好乳化，沖走之後唔會令皮膚感覺油膩或者乾燥。潔面之後，皮膚感覺柔軟、清新、舒適。我特別鍾意佢清潔效果好，但對皮膚仍然好溫和。整體嚟講，我對呢款潔面油非常滿意，會極力推薦！⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text: I picked a random oil cleanser to use as I ran out, and roundlab definitely doesn't disappoint! after using, my skin felt really fresh and clean, but I believe that you really need to scrub your face for makeup to actually wash off + use a face cleanser after. I don't have any complaints
reviews.zh: 我用完咗之前嗰支，隨便揀咗一支潔面油，而 roundlab 絕對冇令我失望！用完之後，皮膚感覺好清新、乾淨，但我覺得要用力擦臉，化妝先至真係洗得走，之後仲要再用返一款洗面產品。我冇咩投訴。

reviews.text: The packaging is quite large. The product will last for a long time. The oil is very liquid, which makes it very easy to apply to the entire face. I tried to wash off a very dry waterproof pencil, it washed off well, but not perfectly, so I recommend using micellar water before washing off. After washing off, there is no film or oil on the skin, the skin is very soft. Easy to use, I like that there is almost no smell, an advantage for me, the composition is good, the frequency of use is every day, the gentle product turns into white milk but does not blind the eyes, moisturizes, the quality is good.
reviews.zh: 包裝幾大，產品可以用好耐。油好清澈，好易搽喺全臉上。我試過洗走一支好乾嘅防水眼線筆，洗得幾乾淨，但唔係完全冇殘留，所以我建議先用卸妝水再沖走。沖完之後，皮膚冇薄膜或者油膜，皮膚好柔軟。易用，我鍾意佢幾乎冇味道，對我嚟講係一個優點。成分好，每日都用，溫和嘅產品乳化成白色奶霜，但唔會刺激眼睛，有補濕效果，質素好好。

reviews.text: I tried this cleansing oil from Round Lab, even though I was not that sure if it would have worked or not, since I have combination/normal skin that tends to be acne prone so I feared that it might have caused a breakout, though so far I’m liking this cleanser, even though it’s an oil it removes makeup and impurities nicely and it leaves the skin completely clean, no need to double cleanse!
reviews.zh: 我試咗呢款 Round Lab 潔面油，雖然唔太肯定會唔會有效，因為我屬混合／正常皮膚，又易長痘，所以我擔心會引起爆痘。不過到目前為止我都幾鍾意呢款潔面產品，雖然係油，但都可以好好咁卸走化妝同污垢，令皮膚完全乾淨，唔需要雙重潔面！

reviews.text: The Round Lab Soybean Cleansing Oil is such a gentle but powerful first cleanser. It has a lightweight, silky texture that glides smoothly over the skin, breaking down makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime effortlessly without needing a lot of rubbing.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 大豆潔面油係一款好溫和但效力強嘅第一步潔面產品。質地輕盈、絲滑，喺皮膚上滑得好順，唔需要大力擦就可以輕鬆分解化妝、防曬同日常污垢。

reviews.text: Skin’s so silky smooth after each use. Really helps with blackheads and hydration—just remember to rub it into the skin for a good 3+ minutes and emulsify it before washing it off completely. It does smell very odd, like earthy, but I don’t mind that at all given the results.
reviews.zh: 用完之後皮膚都好滑溜。真係幫到黑頭同補濕——只要記住，要喺皮膚上按摩至少 3 分鐘，然後乳化再完全沖走。佢嘅味道好奇怪，有啲泥土味，不過我完全唔介意，因為效果咁好。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
